requirements.summary: Root cause from screenshot and runtime configuration: UI at https://localhost:9999 but WebAuthn hard-coded host port from AIDE_PORT default 8097; compose does not pass host AIDE_PORT into container.
evidence: Observed running aide-aide-1 port mapping 127.0.0.1:9999->8080/tcp; no AIDE_PORT in container env; host .env sets AIDE_PORT=9999.

design.summary: Use the request Origin only when it is HTTP(S), localhost, and exactly matches request Host; bind that validated value to each one-use challenge and clone WebAuthn config for finish validation.
evidence: Preserves fixed RP ID localhost and exact same-origin validation while allowing arbitrary launcher host ports.

implementation.summary: Dynamic localhost origin binding now covers both registration and assertion ceremonies; expired/consumed challenges also clear origin state.
